release: Mobile Sales payment collection refresh hotfix
root_cause: After a successful claim, collection-options subtracted a NUMERIC/Decimal pending claim total from a legacy float receivable balance and returned HTTP 500.
fix: Normalize operands to Decimal before calculating available_to_collect; do not modify ledger balances, claim amounts, or LPH status.
api_changes: No new endpoints or request fields. Availability is computed as Decimal and serialized like other monetary workflow fields; the installed APK already accepts decimal strings.
reload: Graceful SIGHUP of the verified production uWSGI master; API UAT and the aaPanel PID alias remain unchanged.

verification.pre_fix_reproduction: Failed with the reported TypeError in both Call Plan and outside-Call-Plan regression cases using DOUBLE PRECISION legacy invoice totals and NUMERIC claims.
regression_coverage: Repeated claims on different invoices and the same invoice
LPH remains AKTIF and receivable is not posted by a claim
verification.production_data_probe: Read-only transactions; both collection origins returned all four eligible invoice rows.
verification.authenticated_http_checks: Six successful collection-options GETs, plus collection history and the active LPH document.
verification.existing_first_claim: Present exactly once in the verified customer history.
verification.physical_android_acceptance_test: Not performed; current APK compatibility checked against its monetary-value parser.

client_action: Reload the payment screen. Do not re-enter the first successful collection.
